title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2
provenance: Reported by freewhirlo7 (highball-db#199, 2026-09-24), Apple M5, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.33, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, DXMT.
notes: Not playable on a Mac. The game uses Easy Anti-Cheat, which works on Linux through its runtime for Proton, and that runtime has no macOS build. The reporter confirms the anti-cheat check crashes the game window. They could only keep playing by repeatedly stopping the check from running and do not recommend it, and it is not recorded as a workaround here, since it defeats the anti-cheat and puts the account at risk.
